text:
{
  "claims": [
    {
      "anchor": "Redis replication is non-blocking on the master side",
      "claim_text": "Redis replication is non-blocking on the master side.",
      "kind": "direct",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [{"sid": "P0.S5", "rel": "entails"}],
      "check": null,
      "reasoning": "Direct restatement of P0.S5."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "after the initial sync a replica keeps serving queries from the old dataset while it loads the new one",
      "claim_text": "After the initial sync, a replica keeps serving queries from the old dataset while it loads the new one.",
      "kind": "direct",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [{"sid": "P0.S10", "rel": "refutes"}],
      "check": null,
      "reasoning": "P0.S10 says after initial sync old dataset must be deleted and new loaded."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "Replicas that reconnect use PSYNC",
      "claim_text": "Replicas that reconnect use the PSYNC command.",
      "kind": "direct",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [{"sid": "P1.S0", "rel": "entails"}],
      "check": null,
      "reasoning": "P1.S0 states replicas use PSYNC when connecting to masters."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "a full resynchronization only happens when the replica's replication ID is unknown to the master",
      "claim_text": "A full resynchronization only happens when the replica's replication ID is unknown to the master.",
      "kind": "logic",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [{"sid": "P1.S2", "rel": "refutes"}],
      "check": null,
      "reasoning": "P1.S2 also lists insufficient backlog as a cause, so 'only' is wrong."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "After a failover the promoted replica keeps its replication ID",
      "claim_text": "After a failover the promoted replica keeps its replication ID.",
      "kind": "direct",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [{"sid": "P2.S4", "rel": "refutes"}],
      "check": null,
      "reasoning": "P2.S4 says it later selects a new random replication ID."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "the old master's replicas can still continue with a partial sync",
      "claim_text": "After a failover, the old master's replicas can still continue with a partial sync.",
      "kind": "direct",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [{"sid": "P8.S0", "rel": "entails"}, {"sid": "P8.S1", "rel": "entails"}],
      "check": null,
      "reasoning": "P8.S0 and P8.S1 together state this."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "which has been possible since Redis 4.0",
      "claim_text": "Partial sync after failover has been possible since Redis 4.0.",
      "kind": "version",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [{"sid": "P8.S0", "rel": "entails"}],
      "check": {"kind": "version", "left": "4.0", "op": ">=", "right": "4.0"},
      "reasoning": "P8.S0 says since Redis 4.0."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "Diskless replication, first available in Redis 2.6.18",
      "claim_text": "Diskless replication was first available in Redis 2.6.18.",
      "kind": "version",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [{"sid": "P4.S1", "rel": "refutes"}],
      "check": {"kind": "version", "left": "2.6.18", "op": ">=", "right": "2.8.18"},
      "reasoning": "P4.S1 says 2.8.18 is the first version."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "sends the RDB to replicas without using the disk as intermediate storage",
      "claim_text": "Diskless replication sends the RDB to replicas without using the disk as intermediate storage.",
      "kind": "direct",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [{"sid": "P4.S2", "rel": "entails"}],
      "check": null,
      "reasoning": "Direct restatement of P4.S2."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "Read-only replicas reject all write commands",
      "claim_text": "Read-only replicas reject all write commands.",
      "kind": "direct",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [{"sid": "P5.S0", "rel": "entails"}],
      "check": null,
      "reasoning": "Direct restatement of P5.S0."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "which makes them safe to expose to untrusted networks",
      "claim_text": "Read-only replicas are safe to expose to untrusted networks.",
      "kind": "direct",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [{"sid": "P5.S1", "rel": "refutes"}],
      "check": null,
      "reasoning": "P5.S1 explicitly says the feature is not intended for untrusted networks."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "Writes made to a writable replica are discarded when the replica and the master resync",
      "claim_text": "Writes made to a writable replica are discarded when the replica and the master resync.",
      "kind": "direct",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [{"sid": "P6.S0", "rel": "entails"}],
      "check": null,
      "reasoning": "P6.S0 states writes are discarded on resync or restart."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "Before Redis 4.0, writable replicas could not expire keys with a TTL",
      "claim_text": "Before Redis 4.0, writable replicas could not expire keys with a TTL.",
      "kind": "direct",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [{"sid": "P7.S0", "rel": "entails"}],
      "check": null,
      "reasoning": "Direct restatement of P7.S0."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "a replica restarted from its AOF file can still be partially resynchronized",
      "claim_text": "A replica restarted from its AOF file can still be partially resynchronized.",
      "kind": "direct",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [{"sid": "P9.S0", "rel": "refutes"}],
      "check": null,
      "reasoning": "P9.S0 says it is not possible."
    }
  ]
}
